integrity: Self-contained analytic proof with finite symbolic and numerical cross-checks; no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns translations shared by each original antipodal vertex pair and preserves those diameter vectors, not all diameter-preserving configurations. Non-dyadic constructions are guaranteed small and strictly convex only for sufficiently small positive perturbations. Earlier equivalent treatments outside indexed sources remain possible.
title: Cyclotomic rigidity and exact diameter-preserving ascent of even regular small polygons
